mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above its 5-year median, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals a tight labor market, which may trigger inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.0%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation level (CPIAUCSL > 250) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) indicates the Federal Reserve is not adequately responding to inflation, leading to expectations of future rate cuts and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 250 AND FEDFUNDS < 2.0%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a below-trend level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates weakening demand for housing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above its 5-year median, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are below their respective 12-month moving averages, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS is above its 5-year median, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
